verdict.rationale: Sticky proxy sessions are a fair question for a web-scraping service, but the evidence pack never documents a session identifier that pins multiple requests to the same proxy IP. The 'no proxy headaches' claim only says proxies are handled for you. The managed browser sessions are for interactive workflows, not proxy-IP persistence, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity
